mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates economic weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increased over the previous three months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 2% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where HOUST decreased by more than 10% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it indicates inflationary pressure coupled with high borrowing costs, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary environment with high interest rates
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 300,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3%, it signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 300,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 300,000 and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increased over two consecutive quarters.
